description.value:
Requirements You're piloting a vehicle.

You drive erratically, swerving from side to side or changing speeds. Attempt a Piloting check against the Fortitude DC of one creature aboard the vehicle you're piloting.

Critical Success You move the creature up to 5 feet in a direction of your choice, and they fall @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Prone]. If they're Climbing on the exterior or your vehicle, you instead knock them off your vehicle.

Success The creature falls prone, or if they're Climbing on the exterior of your vehicle, they're knocked off your vehicle.

Critical Failure A random ally on your vehicle falls prone.
